newsitem.title: GREECE: EUROPEANS SHOW INTEREST IN GREEK EQUITY WARRANTS.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEANS SHOW INTEREST IN GREEK EQUITY WARRANTS.

text.p: European funds were showing increasing interest in Greek equity warrants, ING Barings assistant director for structured products Anjali Bakhru told Reuters.
"There is rising interest from European clients for these products," said Bakhru who was on a business trip to Athens.

ING Barings has issued three call warrants on Greek equities -- a recent warrant on the Athens composite share index launched May 14, a warrant on a basket of six Greek blue-chip shares and a call warrant on a banking basket.
ING Barings does not take a view on the market but delta hedges these products. It uses a tracking basket to delta hedge its index warrant. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
